meta.note: Settings of this run: seed, mission dates, assumptions, totals.

columns.name: key
columns.meaning: Setting name, e.g. seed, launch_utc, day_dose_600, dose_total_msv, storm_shielding_assumption, disclaimer.

columns.name: value
columns.meaning: Setting value, always stored as text (numbers and JSON included).

crew.note: The four fictional crew members and their personal starting values.

columns.name: crew_id
columns.meaning: Crew member id, C1 to C4. C1 (KESTREL) is the focus astronaut of the apps.

columns.name: call_sign
columns.meaning: Fictional call sign: KESTREL, HERON, OSPREY, WREN.

columns.name: role
columns.meaning: Role on board, e.g. flight engineer, commander.

columns.name: sex
columns.meaning: F or M. Selects sex-specific lab cut-offs and NASA condition odds.

columns.name: age
columns.meaning: Age at launch, years.

columns.name: height_cm
columns.meaning: Height, cm.

columns.name: launch_mass_kg
columns.meaning: Body mass at launch, kg. Reference for mass change.

columns.name: eva_team
columns.meaning: EVA team: A (C1 and C3) or B (C2 and C4).

columns.name: baseline_json
columns.meaning: JSON: mean of the 30 pre-launch days for ten daily values (resting heart rate, HRV, blood pressure, blood oxygen, core temperature, sleep, reaction time, wellbeing, body mass).

columns.name: traits_json
columns.meaning: JSON: personal model settings. vo2 = aerobic fitness at launch (mL/kg/min); bone = hip bone change per month in weightlessness (%); sans = optic-disc swelling the person tends to (µm); e_adh, x_adh = how well the person keeps to the food and exercise plan (1 = fully); ortho = sensitivity to standing up after flight (1 = average).

variable.note: The dictionary of all 76 values: label, unit, how it is made, its limits, the rule in words and its source.

columns.name: var_id
columns.meaning: Value id. Body and environment ids equal their column name; arm-unit ids start with eva.; lab ids are values of lab.var_id. Exception: comm_state is the column day.comm.

columns.name: scope
columns.meaning: env, body, lab or eva (arm unit).

columns.name: grp
columns.meaning: Display group, e.g. Air, Radiation, Sleep and mind, Arm unit.

columns.name: label
columns.meaning: Plain-English name shown in the apps.

columns.name: unit
columns.meaning: Unit shown in the apps.

columns.name: decimals
columns.meaning: Decimals to show.

columns.name: cadence
columns.meaning: hourly, daily, every 28 days, every second or under gravity.

columns.name: table_name
columns.meaning: Table that holds the value.

columns.name: column_name
columns.meaning: Column that holds the value. For lab, the value of lab.var_id.

columns.name: kind
columns.meaning: Provenance label: COMPUTED, REPLAY, SIM or MODEL (11_provenance.md).

columns.name: method
columns.meaning: How the generator makes it: computed, replay, model or learned.

columns.name: sensor
columns.meaning: What would measure it on a real mission.

columns.name: region
columns.meaning: Body region or system, for grouping on the body map.

columns.name: catalog_id
columns.meaning: Row id in the indicator catalog (kb/13; indicator.indicator_id in the reference database).

columns.name: hrp_risk
columns.meaning: NASA Human Research Program risk the value belongs to.

columns.name: better
columns.meaning: Direction: high (higher is better), low, band (inside a range) or info (no direction).

columns.name: watch_low
columns.meaning: Watch level, low side, if one number expresses it. Display only: the rules in tools/sim/rules.py decide.

columns.name: watch_high
columns.meaning: Watch level, high side. Display only (see watch_low).

columns.name: warn_low
columns.meaning: Warning level, low side. Display only.

columns.name: warn_high
columns.meaning: Warning level, high side. Display only.

columns.name: crit_low
columns.meaning: Critical level, low side. Display only.

columns.name: crit_high
columns.meaning: Critical level, high side. Display only.

columns.name: rule_text
columns.meaning: The rule in words, as the apps show it.

columns.name: rule_tag
columns.meaning: Source of the thresholds: NASA, CLIN, RES or INF (our assumption), with the reference.

columns.name: why
columns.meaning: Why the value matters, in plain words.

columns.name: action
columns.meaning: What to do when it is flagged.

columns.name: how_simulated
columns.meaning: How the generator makes the value, in words.

columns.name: learned_from
columns.meaning: Dataset a shape was learned from, if any.

columns.name: sort
columns.meaning: Display order.
